hear.en: Could you speak louder so everyone can hear you?
hear.zh: 你可以說大聲一點，讓每個人都聽得到嗎？

ice.en: The ice melted quickly after we placed it in the sun.
ice.zh: 我們把冰放到陽光下後，它很快就融化了。

idea.en: Her idea helped the group solve the problem more efficiently.
idea.zh: 她的想法幫助小組更有效率地解決問題。

ideal.en: A quiet room is ideal for tasks that require deep concentration.
ideal.zh: 安靜的房間很適合需要高度專注的工作。

identify.en: Students should identify the main idea before reading every detail.
identify.zh: 學生應先找出主旨，再閱讀所有細節。

identity.en: The website asks users to confirm their identity before changing passwords.
identity.zh: 網站要求使用者在更改密碼前確認身分。

ignore.en: Do not ignore small errors because they can affect the final result.
ignore.zh: 不要忽略小錯誤，因為它們可能影響最後結果。

ill.en: She stayed home because she felt ill in the morning.
ill.zh: 她早上覺得身體不舒服，所以待在家裡。

illegal.en: It is illegal to enter the protected area without permission.
illegal.zh: 未經許可進入保護區是違法的。

image.en: The image shows how the coastline changed over several decades.
image.zh: 這張影像顯示海岸線在數十年間如何改變。

imagine.en: Imagine how different school would be without computers or the internet.
imagine.zh: 想像一下，如果沒有電腦或網路，學校會有多麼不同。

immediate.en: The damaged equipment requires immediate attention from a technician.
immediate.zh: 受損設備需要技術人員立即處理。

immediately.en: Please report any safety problem immediately to the teacher.
immediately.zh: 若有任何安全問題，請立即向老師報告。

impact.en: The new policy had a positive impact on student participation.
impact.zh: 新政策對學生參與度帶來正面影響。

important.en: It is important to check the source before trusting information online.
important.zh: 相信網路資訊前先查證來源很重要。

impossible.en: The task looked impossible until we divided it into smaller steps.
impossible.zh: 這項任務原本看似不可能，直到我們把它分成較小步驟。

impress.en: Her clear explanation managed to impress the judges at the contest.
impress.zh: 她清楚的解釋成功讓比賽評審留下深刻印象。

improve.en: Regular reading can improve both vocabulary and writing skills.
improve.zh: 規律閱讀可以提升單字量與寫作能力。

improvement.en: The second draft showed clear improvement in organization and grammar.
improvement.zh: 第二版草稿在組織與文法方面有明顯進步。

in.en: Please place the completed worksheet in the blue folder.
in.zh: 請把完成的學習單放進藍色資料夾。

include.en: Your report should include evidence from at least two reliable sources.
include.zh: 你的報告應包含至少兩個可靠來源的證據。

income.en: The survey compared household income with spending on education.
income.zh: 這份調查比較家庭收入與教育支出。

increase.en: Daily practice can increase your reading speed over time.
increase.zh: 每天練習可以逐漸提升閱讀速度。

increasingly.en: Students increasingly use digital tools to organize their schoolwork.
increasingly.zh: 學生愈來愈常使用數位工具整理課業。

indeed.en: The task was indeed difficult, but the team completed it successfully.
indeed.zh: 這項任務確實很困難，但團隊仍成功完成。

independent.en: The project encourages students to become more independent learners.
independent.zh: 這項專題鼓勵學生成為更獨立的學習者。

index.en: Use the index at the back of the book to find the topic.
index.zh: 請使用書後的索引找到這個主題。

indicate.en: The results indicate that most students prefer shorter study sessions.
indicate.zh: 結果顯示，大多數學生偏好較短的讀書時段。

individual.en: Each individual may respond differently to the same learning method.
individual.zh: 每個人對同一種學習方法可能有不同反應。

industry.en: The technology industry changes rapidly as new products are developed.
industry.zh: 隨著新產品不斷開發，科技產業變化迅速。

influence.en: Friends can influence how teenagers choose hobbies and activities.
influence.zh: 朋友可能影響青少年選擇興趣與活動的方式。

inform.en: Please inform the teacher if you cannot attend tomorrow's class.
inform.zh: 如果你明天無法上課，請通知老師。

information.en: Reliable information is essential when making an important decision.
information.zh: 做重要決定時，可靠資訊非常重要。

ingredient.en: Fresh vegetables are an important ingredient in this dish.
ingredient.zh: 新鮮蔬菜是這道料理的重要食材。

initial.en: Our initial plan changed after we received more information.
initial.zh: 我們收到更多資訊後，最初的計畫有所改變。

injure.en: Poor technique can injure players during intense sports practice.
injure.zh: 不正確的技巧可能使球員在激烈運動練習中受傷。

injury.en: He returned to practice after recovering from a knee injury.
injury.zh: 膝傷康復後，他回到練習場。

inner.en: The inner part of the device contains several small sensors.
inner.zh: 這個裝置內部包含數個小型感測器。

insect.en: The students observed an insect through a magnifying glass.
insect.zh: 學生透過放大鏡觀察一隻昆蟲。

inside.en: Please wait inside the building until the rain becomes lighter.
inside.zh: 請在建築物內等待，直到雨勢變小。

insist.en: The teacher insisted that every source be checked before use.
insist.zh: 老師堅持每個資料來源在使用前都必須查證。

inspire.en: The scientist's story inspired many students to study environmental science.
inspire.zh: 這位科學家的故事激勵許多學生學習環境科學。

install.en: The school will install new computers in the library next month.
install.zh: 學校下個月會在圖書館安裝新電腦。

instance.en: For instance, regular review can help move information into long-term memory.
instance.zh: 例如，規律複習能幫助資訊進入長期記憶。

instead.en: We took the train instead because the highway was crowded.
instead.zh: 因為高速公路很塞，我們改搭火車。

instruction.en: Read each instruction carefully before beginning the experiment.
instruction.zh: 開始實驗前請仔細閱讀每項說明。

instrument.en: The laboratory uses a special instrument to measure air pressure.
instrument.zh: 實驗室使用特殊儀器測量氣壓。

insurance.en: Travel insurance can help cover unexpected costs during a trip.
insurance.zh: 旅遊保險可以協助負擔旅途中意外產生的費用。

intelligence.en: The discussion focused on how artificial intelligence may change education.
intelligence.zh: 討論著重於人工智慧可能如何改變教育。

intelligent.en: The system uses intelligent software to organize large amounts of data.
intelligent.zh: 這個系統使用智慧軟體整理大量資料。

intend.en: We intend to finish the first stage before the end of the month.
intend.zh: 我們打算在月底前完成第一階段。

intense.en: The team continued training despite the intense summer heat.
intense.zh: 儘管夏季酷熱，球隊仍持續訓練。

interest.en: Her interest in science grew after visiting the museum.
interest.zh: 參觀博物館後，她對科學的興趣增加了。

interested.en: Many students are interested in learning how robots work.
interested.zh: 許多學生對了解機器人如何運作感興趣。

interesting.en: The article gives an interesting explanation of animal communication.
interesting.zh: 這篇文章對動物溝通提供了有趣的解釋。

international.en: The school joined an international exchange program with several partner schools.
international.zh: 學校加入了與數所姊妹校合作的國際交換計畫。

internet.en: The internet makes it easier to access information from many sources.
internet.zh: 網路讓人更容易取得多種來源的資訊。

interpret.en: Students must interpret the graph before answering the final question.
interpret.zh: 學生必須先解讀圖表，再回答最後一題。

interview.en: She prepared several questions before the interview with the scientist.
interview.zh: 她在訪問科學家前準備了幾個問題。

into.en: The class was divided into four groups for the activity.
into.zh: 全班為了活動被分成四組。

introduce.en: The teacher will introduce the new topic with a short video.
introduce.zh: 老師會用一段短片介紹新主題。

introduction.en: The introduction explains the purpose and structure of the report.
introduction.zh: 前言說明了報告的目的與架構。

invent.en: Students were asked to invent a simple tool for saving water.
invent.zh: 學生被要求發明一個簡單的節水工具。

invention.en: The invention changed how people communicated across long distances.
invention.zh: 這項發明改變了人們遠距溝通的方式。

invest.en: The company plans to invest more money in clean energy.
invest.zh: 這家公司計畫投入更多資金發展潔淨能源。

investigate.en: Scientists will investigate why the water quality changed suddenly.
investigate.zh: 科學家將調查水質突然改變的原因。

investment.en: Education is an important investment in a person's future.
investment.zh: 教育是對個人未來的重要投資。

invite.en: The club plans to invite a local artist to speak.
invite.zh: 社團計畫邀請一位在地藝術家來演講。

involve.en: The project will involve students from several different classes.
involve.zh: 這項專題會有數個不同班級的學生參與。

island.en: The small island is known for its clear water and coral reefs.
island.zh: 這座小島以清澈海水與珊瑚礁聞名。

issue.en: The class discussed an environmental issue affecting many coastal cities.
issue.zh: 全班討論了一個影響許多沿海城市的環境議題。

item.en: Each item on the list must be checked before departure.
item.zh: 出發前必須檢查清單上的每個項目。

itself.en: The machine turns itself off when it becomes too hot.
itself.zh: 機器過熱時會自行關閉。

jacket.en: Bring a light jacket because the evening may become cool.
jacket.zh: 帶一件薄外套，因為晚上可能會變涼。

January.en: The new semester begins in January after the winter break.
January.zh: 新學期會在寒假後的一月開始。

job.en: The volunteer job taught her how to work with different people.
job.zh: 這份志工工作讓她學會如何與不同的人合作。

join.en: Students can join the science club at the start of each semester.
join.zh: 學生可以在每學期開始時加入科學社。

journey.en: The long train journey gave us time to read and rest.
journey.zh: 長途火車旅程讓我們有時間閱讀與休息。

judge.en: The judge asked each team to explain its design clearly.
judge.zh: 評審要求每組清楚說明自己的設計。

July.en: The summer course will begin in early July this year.
July.zh: 今年暑期課程會在七月初開始。

jump.en: The athlete practiced how to jump higher without losing balance.
jump.zh: 這名運動員練習如何跳得更高又不失去平衡。

June.en: Our final presentation is scheduled for the middle of June.
June.zh: 我們的期末報告安排在六月中旬。

just.en: The bus arrived just before the rain started.
just.zh: 公車正好在開始下雨前抵達。
